venues.parkingDetail: There are 40 accessible parking stalls for cars and vans located in the Parking Lot B near the Northeast Main Arena entrance. Anyone using these spaces must display an official state disabled parking permit or license place. There are additional accessible spaces in Lot F south of the Spokane Arena. There are passenger loading zones on Howard Street that serve both the Event and Concourse Levels. There are 7 parking lots for patrons to use.
